about_the_game:
Experience the thrill of arcade rhythm gaming at home.

"PUMP IT UP" is a dance rhythm game that has been loved in arcades around the world for over 25 years.

With five note lanes and precise timing, it delivers a classic rhythm game experience where you press buttons to the beat.

Listen, watch, and press in sync with the music. Feel the immersive gameplay that defines "PUMP IT UP".

Highlights

  • Exclusive songs only in Pump It Up. -  Play iconic tracks like 「Beethoven Virus」, 「Turkey March」, and 「Canon D」, only available in the PIU series.

  • Includes over 200 original songs. - New tracks will continue to be added after the official launch through updates and DLC.

  • Full gamepad support. - Play with ease and enjoy the unique PIU step charts using your preferred controller setup.

  • Compatible with Steam Deck. - Designed with portable play in mind. Enjoy rhythm gaming anytime, anywhere.

  • Difficulty for all user levels. - From beginner-friendly tracks to extreme challenges for expert players, there's something for everyone.

  • Dedicated controller support coming soon. - We are preparing official controller compatibility to bring the full arcade experience to your home.

name: PUMP IT UP RISE

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core i3-4150 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Window 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core i5-8500 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: The legendary arcade rhythm game PUMP IT UP is finally coming to STEAM! Introducing R!SE, the newest entry in the series — now playable at home with your keyboard or gamepad. Play your way, anytime, anywhere!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
